name: CookHoard
purpose: Local cooking assistant for recipes, fridge-aware recommendations, a weekly menu and a unified shopping list. No web server or cloud account is required.
notes: Run npm install once in CookHoard. Faustus launches the MCP process directly; kitchen data is saved locally under COOKHOARD_DATA_DIR or the user's local app-data folder. No website, domain or Supabase service is needed.
